name: Tahera Mannan

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Tahera Mannan also publishes under the name Tahera Moiz Mannan. Her poetry collection “Heartstrings” was published by Cyberwit in 2012. The publisher’s biographical note describes writing as a practice begun in childhood and sustained alongside teaching and family responsibilities. Her poem “A Moment” also appeared in Cultural Reverence in October 2019.

The poem turns an interval of time into a traveller burdened with unfinished tasks. Pain, duty, desire and damaged relationships all make competing demands on a moment that cannot satisfy them. Its personifications create a small drama of exhaustion, ending in a search for something already lost. The apparent simplicity of a fleeting moment opens onto the larger weight of a life’s unresolved obligations.
